title: Anesthesia Testing Equipment
agency: VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.257-NETWORK CONTRACT OFFICE 17 (36C257)
description_text: The Thomas E Creek - Amarillo VA Healthcare System is seeking to purchase equipment for the Healthcare Technology Management (HTM) Department to assist with Preventive Maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting. The equipment being requested must help the HTM Department test virtually all models of ventilators: adult, pediatric, anesthesia, neonatal, and high frequency.
